summary: A long batched writer hold now reports where its longest write spent the time when that write was asked for in a batch stage scope: the fenced run mutation begins one and names its fence-pending and fence-action stages, so projector and rebuild stages inside a long reconcile write show in the hold log and the long-holds report. Batches asked for in an ordinary stage scope stay unstaged.

schema.detail: No table, file or schema change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, retention or digest change.

compatibility.detail: Only the stages field of the writer-hold warning and the long_holds report gains values for batch holds; write behaviour and ordering are unchanged.
